findings.finding: Nonempty full-time save and restore always fail legacy journal operation allowlist before typed full-time replay
findings.proof: Every completed outer contains full_time_outer_begin. Legacy journal_validate allows only reaction/native_transport/stochastic_exposure and throws journal operation otherwise. It also derives accepted_steps/previous_dt only from native_transport. Genesis-only empty journal passes, explaining existing39 controls.
findings.disposition: Separate typed full-time structural/accounting validator required; merely extending allowlist leaves step/dt accounting incorrect. Preserve legacy validator.

findings.finding: Raw options object bytes are memcpy-decoded into bool-bearing GapPicOptions, then read by options_equal without canonical representation validation.
findings.disposition: Versioned typed checked options codec; validate boolean JSON type, integer range and finite numeric/domain constraints before constructing C++ options. Also bind canonical actual options into prefix.

findings.finding: PreparedArena internally stores shared_ptr<const FullTimeAcceptedBoundary> boundary_after but public accessors expose only state prefix, completions and exposure slots.
findings.semantics: Read exactly the final native token boundary without mutable proposal or JSON parsing. Return null for legacy/private child tokens, and preserve the candidate boundary after publication as immutable metadata. Root compares field/heat/source/RNG/time/revision/common seals before any owner publication. No implementation added.
